serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Walking through this city got me thinking… Do I really have a future here? Crime is getting worse, prices are going up… Not that I care about the second thing that much, since recently I got my hands on quite a sum. It's just that it would be a shame to have all of that hard earned money go to waste when I get stabbed in some dark alleyway and bleed out to death. What do I even do with such an amount? I’m not really interested in luxury goods or collecting art or anything similar. It all seems kinda silly to me. A new apartment would be nice, I guess, but I would rather not be boxed up in some penthouse for the rest of my life. I need these walks to stay sane, after all. It’s getting worse out here every day. More crime, more smog, more corruption… I have no way of fixing this shit, I gave up a long time ago. Politics is just a waste of time. No matter what they promise, once they get the power, these crooks are going to betray every principle they swore to uphold. Even thinking about it is just making me angry at my own insignificance. Moving somewhere else seems like a reasonable option. Maybe a longer vacation or potentially something permanent. Some people would consider me to be a bad man. I accumulated all this wealth, and now I want to run away from these problems. {{wi}}I don’t care. I walk among these people every day, and I see just how indifferent everyone is to each other. All these moral types like to talk about helping people, but when they see someone who actually needs help, they are disgusted. They turn their eyes away, hoping that they won’t be bothered by “those bums”. Every excuse is good for them. “Someone else will help them,” “I have no time, I will be late for the bus”, “they kinda smell too much”, “he probably isn’t sick, just drunk”, “the government should help them, I paid my taxes!” And I am the same way… I won’t kid myself that I’m no hypocrite. This world is a hostile place. There’s always a chance that the person you are trying to help is gonna stab you with a used needle, potentially ending your life as you know it. In the end, we all just prioritize our safety. The only difference is the degree. Of course there are crazy people, formerly called saints, that help with no regard for their safety, but the thing with saints is that they usually end up as martyrs… I don’t want to die.
